title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Frequent-Rider Credit Points
content:
# Frequent-rider credit points (Wayfare Pass)

**Clause.** When Pass ride credit is posted for a trip of a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) member, the frequent-rider points depend on the member's credit history and tenure: 2 percentage points for a member with at least 12 credit earn entries posted in the last three months and at least 24 whole months of membership; 1 percentage point for a member who does not meet that tier but has at least 6 such entries and at least 12 whole months; nothing for anyone else.

**Effect.** The points are added to the plan's Pass ride credit rate for that trip; the trip's credit is then that higher rate applied to the eligible fare.

## Records read

- **Credit earn entries**: the credit earn entries on the membership ledger posted in the last three months, one per trip that earned credit.
- **Whole months of membership**: whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the date of posting.

## Tier table

| Credit earn entries, last three months | Whole months of membership | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | 24 or more | 2 |
| 6 or more (including 12 or more) | 12 to 23 | 1 |
| 6 to 11 | 24 or more | 1 |
| under 6 | any | nothing |
| any | under 12 | nothing |

## Edges (hypothetical members)

- 12 entries and 24 months: 2 points. 11 entries and 24 months: 1 point. 12 entries and 23 months: 1 point.
- 6 entries and 12 months: 1 point. 5 entries and 30 months: nothing. 20 entries and 11 months: nothing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A Wayfare Pass Monthly member (credit rate 6 percent) at the 2-point tier takes credit at 8 percent: on an eligible fare of 30.00 that is 2.40.
